# Web Developer | Hassan Biswas — UI/UX & Front-End Architecture

> Freelance Front-End Developer & Website Designer specializing in transforming Figma, Framer, and Webflow designs into high-performance, accessible, and SEO-friendly digital experiences.

Hassan Biswas is a Web Developer based in Jashore, Khulna, Bangladesh with 3+ years of experience in front-end development, custom Web Components, zero-dependency lightweight architectures, and modern web performance optimization.

## Core Services & Specializations

- **UI/UX & Web Design:** Transforming Figma, Framer, and Webflow concepts into clean, pixel-perfect user interfaces.
- **Front-End Development:** High-performance, responsive web architectures built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript.
- **Figma/Design-to-Code Conversion:** Fast, SEO-optimized static sites built with Awwwards-inspired aesthetics.
- **Automation & CI/CD:** GitHub Actions automation, zero-maintenance site deployments, and release workflows.
